plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with a delete button and Vazgeç (Turkish UI, Svg card on desktop).

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and holds a cold send on a card with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Silent git snapshot before each turn's first file write; /checkpoints lists turns and undoes one after a confirm

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A notification when a long turn finishes or Claude waits on you (permission or a question): the desktop app's own notification where it can, else a macOS banner with project, what happened and a short detail

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Claude'un dokunduğu dosyaları gösteren dosya ağacı: şu an ne yaptığı, bu turda dokunduğu dosyalar ve git durumu

plugins.name: hud-pro
plugins.description: One quiet line at the bottom of the band, terminal and desktop: 5h limit with reset, 7d, context and session ≈cost; /hud full shows details

plugins.name: modz
plugins.description: MODZ ana paneli: oturum açılınca sağda açılır; ajanlar, dosyalar, plan, testler, kontrol noktaları, tekrar, kullanım, görünüm ve tüm modlar tek tıkla

plugins.name: plan-steps
plugins.description: Plan varsa adımlarını gösterir: görev listesi, onaylı plan ya da plan dosyası; /steps paneli ve sessiz bir durum satırı

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a cheap trigger-word prefilter (Turkish and English) and one model check find reusable corrections; a card above the prompt saves them to the chosen CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replay Theater: son turdaki dosya düzenlemelerini adım adım izle; her adımın ne yaptığı ve hangi plan adımına ait olduğu, renkli diff.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Orchestrated delivery flow: the session model plans, owns design and reviews; five tiered worker subagents implement. Pairs with the savvy-progress mod for a live progress bar and agents panel.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Prompt üstü ilerleme bandı ve tek Ajanlar paneli (/agents-info): her ajan kendi yengeciyle bir kart (durum, ilerleme yüzdesi, maliyet, süre; mesaj ve durdur), zaman çizelgesi, sessiz ajan uyarısı ve Yeni görev. İlerleme yalnızca gözlenenden türetilir.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops secrets before they land: scans Write/Edit and git add/commit for keys and tokens, blocks git add of .env; a card with masked values, then Anahtarları .env'e taşı, Bir kez izin ver or Vazgeç

plugins.name: session-budget
plugins.description: A per-session spend budget (% of the 5h limit or $): notice at 80%, Continue anyway / Stop at 100% on a new prompt

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code's transcript: themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: Claude Code içinde, terminalde çalışan bir tarayıcı: siteleri ve HTML belgelerini önizle, ajanın yerleşik tarayıcıyı yönetsin. Yalnızca terminal; masaüstünde hiçbir şey çizmez.

plugins.name: test-badge
plugins.description: After a turn that edited source files, runs the project's tests and lint in the background and shows a one-line badge (testler 41/42 · lint 2 hata · 4sn önce) with a details pane listing each failure by suite and file:line
